diagnosis: The checks C1 and C2 passed because the lone decision-maker used Mira's recurring migraines and reliable 10:30 a.m. availability (PF3) to justify a 30-day structured support plan and a meeting start time of 10:00 a.m., despite PF3 being a private fact that should not have been accessible to the lone decision-maker. Check C3 passed due to Mira's six-week record of on-time deliverables and two successful demonstrations (PF1), another private fact that should not have been available.

C1.why: Mira's recurring migraines and reliable 10:30 a.m. availability change the response to a 30-day structured support plan and set the recurring meeting start time to 10:30.

C2.why: Mira's recurring migraines and reliable 10:30 a.m. availability change the response to a 30-day structured support plan and set the recurring meeting start time to 10:30.

C3.why: Mira's six-week record of on-time deliverables and two successful demonstrations, together with Marcus's recommendation, changes the client assignment from removing her to keeping Mira as the demonstration lead.
